item.title: Grammys 2027 Predictions: Who Could Score a Nomination in the Biggest Categories?
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news and trends. Today, we're talking about the upcoming 69th annual Grammy Awards. With a new rule change in the best new artist category, some exciting possibilities are opening up for artists like Ella Langley. Let's break it down."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Thanks to this rule change, Ella Langley could be nominated in four of the six general field categories, including album, record, and song of the year, plus best new artist. If she achieves this, she'll be the first country crossover artist to do so since Bobbie Gentry in 1968. Other artists like Olivia Dean, Olivia Rodrigo, and Taylor Swift are also potential nominees in multiple categories."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The eligibility period for the Grammys runs from August 31st, 2025, to August 28th, 2026, with first-round voting taking place from October 12th to 22nd. Nominations will be announced on November 16th. We're also seeing some historic moments possible, with Paul McCartney potentially earning his 10th career nomination for Album of the Year, and Taylor Swift potentially earning her eighth nod in the same category."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Some notable albums that could be nominated for Album of the Year include Olivia Dean's 'The Art of Loving', Noah Kahan's 'The Great Divide', and Ella Langley's 'Dandelion'. We'll have to wait and see who makes the cut, but one thing's for sure - this year's Grammys are shaping up to be exciting. Stay tuned for more updates, and thanks for listening!"
[Outro music plays]
